versions.content: On reception of request for DM29 (call of J1939Dcm_RequestIndication with pa rameter requestedPgn set according Table column “PGN (Hexadecimal)”) the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall call for each byte in the response message the Dem_J1939DcmSetDTCFilter with the parameters ‘ DTCStatusFilter ’ and ‘DTCKind’ as defined by Table 3 .
